Tempo and beat

If you do not know it, leave it at 120.
A faster tempo raises the pitch, a slower one lowers it.
Original Changes the pitch without changing the tempo. Works best within a few semitones.
Key – An estimate from the melody and chords. Hard techno with little melody can be unclear. The second code is the Camelot key (for DJ mixing).
The Delay timing uses this.

Length

Wrapped: the tail that would run past the end is mixed into the start, so the file stays the same length and loops with its tail, like a repeating kick.

    Privacy and terms

    Privacy

    Your audio file never leaves your device: editing and rendering happen entirely in your browser. The site does not collect or store any data, does not use cookies, and there is no registration. If you refresh the page or leave, everything is lost. The fonts are loaded from Google Fonts, so your browser may contact Google servers to display the page.

    Terms of use

    This site is a free hobby project and works "as is", with no guarantee of operation or of being error-free. Only upload audio you have the rights to. The edited file and how you use it are your responsibility. Keep a copy of your original file before editing.
